_readme: Information checked by hand on Italian universities' OWN websites. 'universities' = rules that apply to all international applicants of that university (keys: university slug). 'programmes' = details for one programme (keys: 'university-slug/programme-slug', see the page address). Use null for anything the official page does not state. Dates YYYY-MM-DD. See CONTENT-GUIDE.md.

padova.englishRequirement: At least B2 level; accepted certificates and minimum scores are listed by the university. Certificates can be submitted after applying, but no later than 31 July 2027.
padova.notes: Applications are made on apply.unipd.it (not used for single-cycle Medicine and Surgery). The first call for 2027/28 has closed — check the website for any later call.

roma-la-sapienza.applicationFee: €30 per application, maximum two applications per academic year; no fee waiver.
roma-la-sapienza.tuition: Sapienza states full tuition of €300–1,500 per year for bachelor’s and master’s programmes, depending on country of residence. Merit and income-based scholarships exist.
roma-la-sapienza.englishRequirement: At least upper-intermediate (B2) English or Italian, depending on the programme.

deadlines.label: 2027/28 pre-selection
deadlines.text: Dates not yet published. For 2026/27, non-EU applicants needing a visa could apply from 22 Dec 2025 to 15 May 2026.

roma-la-sapienza.notes: Pre-selection on Sapienza’s MoveIn platform is mandatory for English-taught programmes, followed by Universitaly pre-enrolment for non-EU applicants.

milano-politecnico.applicationFee: €50 for master’s (Laurea Magistrale) applicants with a foreign qualification — mandatory, non-refundable, cannot be waived.
milano-politecnico.englishRequirement: An English language certificate is part of the application; check the programme’s call for the level required.

deadlines.label: Master’s application periods
deadlines.text: Differ by semester and by nationality (non-EEA, EEA, non-EEA living in Italy) — see the current call.

milano-politecnico.notes: Up to two master’s programmes per semester (1st and 2nd choice). Design and Architecture master’s programmes accept applications for the 1st semester only. Rules shown are for master’s applicants.

bologna.applicationFee: €50 to register for a master’s selection (example: International Management, 2026/27) — paid on Studenti Online.
bologna.tuition: Calculated from the ISEE family-income certificate; applicants without an ISEE have fees calculated from their country of origin and where their family holds income and assets. Exemptions are possible for low ISEE.
bologna.englishRequirement: CEFR B2 for English-taught master’s programmes (example: International Management, 2026/27). The university’s free online English test (OOPT) at B2 or higher is accepted.

deadlines.label: 2027/28 calls
deadlines.text: Not yet published — each programme publishes its own call on its “How to enrol” page. For 2026/27 the OOPT booking deadline for International Management was 13 March 2026.

bologna.notes: Each degree programme at Bologna has its own call, places (some reserved for non-EU citizens living abroad) and deadlines. Rules shown come from the International Management master’s page as an example.

milano.applicationFee: €30 per master’s application (credit card from abroad).
milano.englishRequirement: Set by each programme — see the programme description.

deadlines.label: 2027/28 calls
deadlines.text: Not yet published. For 2026/27 applications opened on 22 January 2026; other deadlines fell between July and October.

milano.notes: Applications through ammissionimagistrali.unimi.it. You can enrol only after the programme’s admission board approves you.

torino-politecnico.applicationFee: €50, non-refundable, paid online by credit card (PagoPA).
torino-politecnico.englishRequirement: English B2 or higher for English-taught programmes (Italian-taught or bilingual programmes also need Italian B2). Accepted certificates are listed in the university’s chart; TOEFL results to code C285. Exemptions for some IB holders and English-taught qualifications from listed countries.

deadlines.label: 2027/28 calls
deadlines.text: Not yet published — in 2026/27 the 1st call opened on 19 December 2025.

torino-politecnico.notes: Rules shown are for master’s applicants with a non-Italian qualification.

palermo.englishRequirement: English-taught programmes: IELTS Academic 5.5, TOEFL iBT 72, PTE 46 or higher; Trinity ISE II–IV, British Institutes and Cambridge English qualifications are also accepted.

deadlines.label: Deadlines
deadlines.text: See the enrolment procedure for non-EU students on the university’s website.

trento.applicationFee: €30 application fee; €100 confirmation fee if admitted.
trento.tuition: For English-taught master’s degrees, tuition depends on the admission score.
trento.englishRequirement: CEFR B2 — an English certificate, a university statement that your degree was taught in English, or a self-declaration if you come from or graduated in an English-speaking country.

deadlines.label: 2027/28 calls
deadlines.text: Not yet published — each master’s programme publishes its own non-EU admission page.

trento.notes: Each programme has its own admission page for non-Europeans; rules shown are from the Computer Science master’s.

pavia.applicationFee: €35 per call, mandatory and non-refundable — pay before the call deadline.
pavia.englishRequirement: Set by each programme — see the programme’s call.

deadlines.label: 2027/28 3rd call closes — EU and non-EU residing in Italy only

pavia.notes: Calendar for programmes without restricted access. Later calls depend on seat availability. Non-EU applicants needing a visa should apply in the first calls.

pisa.tuition: 2026/27: maximum all-inclusive fee €2,900 a year for regular students, reduced according to family income.
pisa.englishRequirement: Set by each English-taught programme — see its call.

deadlines.label: Deadlines
deadlines.text: Each programme’s call sets them; non-EU applicants must also pre-enrol on Universitaly.

pisa.notes: English-taught master’s applications from non-EU citizens living abroad go through applymscenglish.unipi.it.

bolzano.englishRequirement: B2 certification in at least two of the three official languages (Italian, German, English); some master’s programmes are taught only in English.

deadlines.label: Deadlines
deadlines.text: See “Information for non-EU citizens living abroad” on the university’s website.

torino.englishRequirement: Set by each programme — see the programme on apply.unito.it.
torino.notes: From 2027/28 Apply@Unito accepts visa applicants for each programme only up to four times its quota of places, then closes that programme.

milano-bocconi.englishRequirement: Not needed for selection, but a valid English certificate must be provided by the enrolment deadline and by the end of June 2027 at the latest.
milano-bocconi.notes: Rounds shown are for Master of Science programmes. Places in the most popular programmes and most scholarships are more likely to be given in earlier rounds.

genova.applicationFee: €30 for the 2027/28 pre-selection (covers up to two assessment applications).
genova.englishRequirement: Not stated on the admissions page — see the programme page. Italian is not required for English-taught courses.

deadlines.label: 2027/28 visa-applicant pre-selection
deadlines.text: Expected to open in mid-December 2026 and close at the end of March 2027 — exact dates not yet published.

l-aquila.englishRequirement: Set in each call — see the call document.

deadlines.label: Other 2027/28 master’s calls
deadlines.text: Not yet published. For 2026/27 the master’s taught in English deadline was 25 February 2026.

l-aquila.notes: Calls for students with a foreign bachelor’s degree; applications through pica.cineca.it/univaq.

milano-bicocca.englishRequirement: An English certificate from the university’s accepted list (valid five years), due by 5 February 2027 for the 1st call.
milano-bicocca.notes: Choose “NON EU residing abroad” if you need a study visa. Visa applicants must arrive in Italy by 31 January 2028.

siena.englishRequirement: B2 for single-cycle and master’s programmes taught in English (B1 for the Foundation Course), with a certificate from the university’s accepted list or an Italian university language centre. Citizens of the US, UK, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand and Malta are exempt, as are applicants whose entry qualification was taught in English.

deadlines.label: 2027/28 calendar
deadlines.text: Not yet published. In 2026 the non-EU visa deadline for bachelor’s, single-cycle and master’s was 6 May 2026.

siena.notes: Applications outside your category’s period are rejected and fees are not refunded.

perugia.englishRequirement: Set by programme. Engineering Management requires a B2 English certificate from the university’s list (medium-of-instruction letters are rejected).

deadlines.label: 2027/28 deadlines
deadlines.text: Not yet published. In 2026 the general pre-evaluation for visa applicants ran from 29 May to 7 June 2026.

perugia.notes: Apply first through the PICA pre-evaluation portal (one application per candidate), then pre-enrol on Universitaly.

messina.applicationFee: 2027/28: €40, non-refundable — covers up to two applications.
messina.englishRequirement: CEFR B2 for English-taught programmes: IELTS 5.5, TOEFL iBT 72, Cambridge B2 First, PTE General Level 3 (B2) or PTE Academic 59 (certificates valid two years). Exempt: native speakers from listed countries, degrees taught entirely in English there, IB Diploma in English, or programmes using a standardised English test such as IMAT.
messina.notes: Up to two pre-evaluation applications. Incomplete applications are rejected; calls may close early when full.

roma-luiss.notes: Bachelor’s admission for non-EU applicants is either with an international qualification (SAT, LSAT, ACT or IB) or through the online Luiss Test in February 2027.

bari-politecnico.englishRequirement: English B2 is required for 13 English-related master’s degrees (2026/27). Poliba checks it with its own online test (30 questions in 15 minutes, pass mark 21/30), booked through the Microsoft Teams team “2026/27 B2 requirement assessment for master’s degrees” up to three working days before a session. The page does not list external certificates.
bari-politecnico.notes: Architecture has its own B2 requirement. Questions: languages@poliba.it.

roma-tre.englishRequirement: Not stated on the international enrolment page — check the programme’s admission notice.

deadlines.label: 2026/27 Universitaly pre-enrolment — non-EU applicants needing a visa (past cycle)

roma-tre.notes: Non-EU applicants living abroad pre-enrol on Universitaly for a preliminary evaluation; the visa decision is made by the Italian embassy or consulate. The 2027/28 date has not been published yet.

verona.tuition: Students with a study visa or study residence permit may qualify for a flat fee: €500 a year (low and lower-middle income countries, World Bank list) or €1,000 (upper-middle income countries).
verona.englishRequirement: No English test is listed on the page; English-taught master’s applicants are exempt from the Italian test (CISIA ITA-L2). Check the programme’s own requirements.
verona.notes: Pre-enrolment and the visa request go through Universitaly, for one programme at one university. 2027/28 dates are not published yet.

marche.englishRequirement: Seven programmes are taught entirely in English; the page does not state the English level — see the 2026/27 international admissions page.
marche.notes: After a positive pre-acceptance email, non-EU students who need a visa pre-enrol on Universitaly. Univpm offers 120 scholarships of €2,000 for first-time students enrolling in 2026/27.

calabria.tuition: UnicalAdmission scholarship winners have tuition fees covered.
calabria.englishRequirement: Set in the UnicalAdmission call for each master’s programme.
calabria.notes: Unical says the UnicalAdmission call for non-EU master’s applicants for 2027/28 will be published on its page, likely in January 2027. For 2026/27 it awarded 132 scholarships covering tuition, free board and lodging and a €3,600 allowance.

parma.englishRequirement: See Parma’s language requirements page and the programme call on the Admissions Portal.
parma.notes: Calls open to international applicants are published on the Parma Admissions Portal (apply.unipr.it). For 2026/27 the call for English-taught master’s for non-EU visa applicants ran from 15 January to 7 April 2026; the 2027/28 call is not published yet.
